name: Igal (Hungary)
description: Pale blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Igal: a blue shield with a white bend and a Hungarian shield, with a helm, a lion crest and red, yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Igal arms with helm, crest and mantling
